created_prompt: I create cooking videos.  During these videos I supply a quick and healthy recipe to my  viewers.  I want to grow my online audience and I also want to create and publish a cookbook with my recipes.  Can you supply me a three year plan with actual practical steps to grow my online presence and also so that at the end of three years I am able to publish my book.  You need to account for preparation for the videos, research for how to publish the book, collection, sorting and editing of recipes and more.  I can work four days a week on this project and I have a limited budget.
